## About us

Malachyte is a transformational personalization solution designed to proactively adapt every online experience to shoppers in real time, leveraging instant and continuous learning to hit the optimal engagement sweet spot, while future-proofing brands for the attention economy. Built by former Spotify and Google experts, Malachyte’s Modular Intelligence Engine is trailblazing the next era of AI tools to help brands identify, understand, and engage their customers with unprecedented precision.Our goal is to make the latest AI technologies accessible to everyone, regardless of industry or organization. We strive to simplify how AI tools are adopted, to empower businesses to easily adapt to market changes and anticipate customer needs. By helping organizations use AI to improve how they handle data and interact with customers, we support them in boosting efficiency and driving growth and innovation.Launch - Fall 2025Specialties:Personalization, AI Search, Product Discovery, SaaS, Customer Experience, Guided Selling, Product Discovery and Recommendations.
